Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your DayThis role is being created as an addition to the ERP Competence Centre to address the business need for a new project, the S4E program. The primary objective is to provide dedicated oversight and management for the external implementation partner, ensuring their delivery aligns with strategic program goals and contractual obligations. To achieve this, the role is structured around three core areas: Provider Performance & Governance, Contract & Commercial Management, and Stakeholder & Delivery Integration. This focus ensures the providers performance is actively steered against KPIs, contractual and scope changes are managed effectively, and the partners work is seamlessly integrated with internal teams and other third parties. Given the focus on these areas, the ideal candidate will be a Senior Professional with extensive experience in managing large-scale IT service providers within complex ERP programs. They must possess strong skills in contract management, performance monitoring, and stakeholder influence to successfully navigate the demands of the S4E program.How Youll Make an ImpactSteer and monitor the external implementation partners performance against contractual KPIs, service level agreements, and key deliverables for the S4E program.Establish and lead regular performance review meetings and governance forums to track progress, address operational issues, and ensure alignment with project goals.Act as the primary escalation point for service delivery issues, driving resolution between the provider and internal stakeholders.Manage the end-to-end process for scope changes and contractual adjustments in close collaboration with the Contract Management and Procurement teams.Oversee the commercial aspects of the provider relationship, including budget tracking, invoice validation, and financial reporting.Ensure all contractual obligations are understood and met by both the provider and the internal organization.Ensure the seamless integration of the providers delivery model with all interfacing internal teams and other third-party vendors.Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the implementation partner and internal business and IT stakeholders to resolve dependencies.Develop and maintain strong working relationships across the program to ensure smooth project execution and alignment on provider-related matters.What You BringBachelors or Masters degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.Significant professional experience in IT provider management, vendor management, or project management, preferably within large-scale ERP (SAP S/4HANA) transformation programs.Demonstrated experience in managing contracts, SLAs, and performance KPIs for external service providers.Experience in vendor and project management, including customer relationship management, project planning, change management, risk management, and workflow management to support successful project delivery, effective stakeholder engagement, and strong vendor partnerships.Expertise in governance and domain engagement, informed decision???making, and the successful resolution of business and operational challenges.About the TeamOur Global Functions play a key role in advancing the companys central These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you supply to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external collaborators, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company.
